description: Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10): status code, Location and server for each hop, final URL, and loop detection. Useful for link unshortening and SEO migrations. Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
